title: Marvelous Designer License ID Web Login Restriction (Effective Sept 30, 2026)
content: Effective September 30, 2026, Marvelous Designer will restrict website login access for all License IDs. After this date, License IDs can only be used to log into the software itself. Any website-related tasks, such as account management or license purchases, must be performed by your team administrator using the Company ID. Software operations and workflow will remain completely unaffected. * * * ## **1\. Key Policy Changes (Effective Sept 30, 2026)** ### **Website Login Restriction for License IDs** Starting September 30, 2026, you will no longer be able to log into the Marvelous Designer website using a License ID. * **Action Required:** If you need to change your account information or password on the website, you must log in using your team's main administrator account (the **Company ID**) or request your team administrator to manage it for you. ### **Account Separation and Email Information Updates (CLO-SET Integration)** Due to the web login restriction, the email information registered to your License ID will be processed based on your current CLO-SET integration status: * **Not integrated with CLO-SET:** All email information previously registered to the License ID will be securely removed. * **Currently integrated with CLO-SET:** The existing integration will be discontinued, and the accounts will be separated. However, to ensure smooth software access without disruption, your original CLO-SET email address will be automatically registered into the [User Pool](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358149827609 "https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358149827609-User-Pool-Manual") of the corresponding License ID. * * * ## **2\. What Remains Unchanged?** ### **Seamless Software Access** You can log in and use the Marvelous Designer software exactly as you do now. * **Zero Impact on Workflow:** Please be assured that this measure is strictly limited to 'website login'. It will not affect your software operation, rendering, or daily working environment. * * * ## **3\. Understanding Account Types: Company ID vs. License ID** To help manage this transition, please note the distinct roles of the two account types: * **Company ID (Administrator Account):** This is the essential administrator account required to log into the website, purchase licenses, and manage License IDs. The administrator can assign licenses to individual users and monitor overall usage. * **License ID (Practitioner Account):** This account is assigned to practitioners and used **solely for software login**. It cannot be used for website login or direct license purchases. * * * ## **4\. Need Assistance?** If you do not know your Company ID, or if you are an administrator who has lost access to your Company ID, please do not hesitate to reach out for help. 👉 [**Contact our Support Team**](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/support/contact "https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/ko/support/contact")
content_description: This webpage informs users of the upcoming changes to Marvelous Designer's login policy, effective September 30, 2026, which will restrict License IDs from accessing the website and outline necessary actions for account management through the Company ID.

title: Add Pattern Thickness
content: ### ### Objective Extrude garment to express thickness. (These settings will apply to mesh export when using Thick export option, or use for 3D display only). ### Location 2D Toolbar ▶ Edit Pattern / Transform Pattern 3D Window ▶ Garment Display Option ▶ Wireframe on Monochrome (Thick) (ver. 2024.2) ### ### Operation (ver. 2024.2) 1. Follow the guideline below to set Garment Display Option to Wireframe on Monochrome (Thick). 3D Window ▶ Garment Display Option ▶ Wireframe on Monochrome (Thick) 2. Follow the indicated guideline below: 2D Toolbar ▶ Edit Pattern / Transform Pattern 3. Select a Pattern or Pattern line to express doubled sided effect. → Its properties appear in the Property Editor. 4. Property Editor ▶ Geometry → Modifies the Geometry Properties which will affect mesh style / extrusion direction when exporting with thickness. #### Geometry Properties Add'l Thickness - Rendering (mm) | Displays the added thickness in addition to the Thickness value of Fabric Style. ---|--- Extrusion Direction | Sets the direction to display the thickness. Both | Apply the thickness front/rear around the pattern. Forward | Apply the thickness in the front direction of the pattern. Backward | Apply the thickness in the rear direction of the pattern. Toggle each side on or off to determine whether to generate the Mesh. (ver. 2025.0) Front Face | Set whether or not the front part is displayed based on the normal direction. Back Face | Set whether or not the back part is displayed based on the normal direction. Seam Face | Set whether or not to show overlapping sides on the sewn line. Side Geometry | Curvature (%) | Set side geometry lateral curvature percentage. Resolution | Set divisions for the side mesh. Double Side | Apply Curvature attribute values to both front and back symmetrical from the pattern. UV Expansion (ver. 2025.0) | The Side and Back UVs can be edited in UV Editor. [**Video here**](https://youtu.be/6e8yRsHUv_8) Back Face | Check this on to show the back face UV. Side Face | Check this on to show the side thickness UV. Mesh Style | Triangle | Re-mesh the pattern using triangular mesh option Quad (Optimized) | Re-mesh the pattern using quadrangular mesh option. Generates aligned automatic Retopology results. Quad (Grid) | Re-mesh the pattern using quadrangular mesh option. Generates pattern with a uniform grid. Face Count | Display total face count of the pattern. Vertex Count | Display total vertex count of the pattern. ※ Note: To use UV Expansion, Thick Textured surface must be active in the 3D window. ### Operation (Ver. 2024.1 and below) 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: 2D Toolbar ▶ Edit Pattern / Transform Pattern 2. Select a Pattern or Pattern line to express doubled sided effect. → Its properties appear in the Property Editor. 3. Property Editor ▶ Selected Line ▶ Curved Side Geometry ▶ Check on Double Sided → The selected Pattern or Pattern line is now being displayed as double sided.
content_description: This web page provides detailed instructions for setting up and utilizing the Thick export option in garment design software to effectively visualize and modify the thickness of patterns in both 2D and 3D environments.

title: Personal Account & License Management Guide
content: ## **Personal ID Guideline** _**Personal ID:**_ A Personal ID is an account for all personal license users. Personal ID can only purchase personal licenses. ### **How to use**[**My Account**](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage) **Page** #### **Dashboard** ![스크린샷 2026-03-06 오후 4.00.34.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/55756835815577) In the Dashboard section, you can view the general information of your account, as well as the licenses you possess at the moment. * * * #### **Account** ![스크린샷 2026-03-06 오후 4.06.02.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/55756839855001) In the **Account** section, you can review and manage your profile details. In addition to modifying your **Name, Occupation, and Billing Address** , you can access the following features: * **My Coupon** : View your available coupons or enter a coupon code to redeem rewards. * **Preferred Language** : Set your preferred language for the marketing communications. Marketing emails will be sent in the language corresponding to this setting. * **Password Management** : Change or reset your **CLO-SET Password** and **Marvelous Designer License Password** independently. * **Newsletter Subscription** : Toggle your subscription to receive product updates, events, and special offers directly in your inbox. * **AI Studio Plug-In** : Manage access to integrated AI features within Marvelous Designer. * **Account Deletion** : If you no longer require access, you can permanently delete your account from this section. * * * #### **License** ![스크린샷 2026-03-06 오후 4.26.26.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/55756839856025) On the License section, you can check the Name of the product you have/ Expiry date of it/ Different versions of installers on Windows and Mac OS, Cancellation. In the **License** section, you can manage your active subscriptions and payment details: * **Check Subscription Status** : Monitor your current product name, plan type, and your current **Active** status. * **Manage Payment & Next Payment Date**: View and update your **Payment Method** and credit card information, and check the scheduled date for your **Next Payment**. * **Cancel or Pause Subscription** : You have the option to **Cancel Subscription** or manage the continuation of your current subscription directly from this dashboard. * **Order History & Invoice Download**: Access your **Order History** to review past transactions, including the order date, product name, and total charge, and access your **Invoice** for each billing cycle.
content_description: The Personal ID Guideline page serves as a comprehensive resource for personal license users, detailing account management, subscription oversight, and personalized features to enhance user experience.

title: Auto Fitting
content: Create Fitting Suit Auto Fitting & Re-Target Draping/Re-Drape 3D Arrangement (ver. 2025.0) Show Avatar Fitting Suit (Above ver. 11) Show Garment Fitting Suit (Above ver. 11) * * * ## Create Fitting Suit ### Objective Create a Fitting Suit for a custom avatar for Auto Fitting. Create a Fitting Suit Reference Line along the avatar surface and apply Fitting Suit. ### Location Main Menu ▶ Avatar ▶****[**Avatar Editor**](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358128221337) ▶ Create Fitting Suit (ver. 2025.0) Main Menu ▶ 3D Garment ▶ Create Fitting Suit (ver. 10 - 2024.2) 3D Toolbar ▶ Create Fitting Suit (ver. 10-2024.2) ### Operation 1\. Load your custom avatar. 2\. Select the tool/menu indicated in Location for your version. 3\. Create Fitting Suit Reference Line following the guide of dialogue and mouse pointer. → When you have finished creating the lines, the preview of the Fitting Suit appears. 4\. After creating all reference lines, press Apply button. → Fitting Suit is simulated on the avatar. 5\. Press Save button to save the avatar. → It is saved as an avatar file (.avt) including Fitting Suit data. ※Note If you do not want to create symmetry, turn off Symmetry settings. If you want to recreate the reference line, select the reference line in the dialogue and press the Delete button. * * * ## Auto Fitting & Re-Target Draping/Re-Drape 3D Arrangement (ver. 2025.0) ### Objective **Auto Fitting** Automatically adjust the size of your garment to your custom avatar and simulate the garment. **Re-Target Draping / Re-Drape 3D Arrangement (ver. 2025.0)** Simulate garment on your custom avatar. (This function maintains its original size) ### Location **Auto Fitting** Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Fitting ▶ Auto Fitting 2D Toolbar ▶ Auto Fitting **Re-Target Draping / Re-Drape 3D Arrangement (ver. 2025.0)** Main Menu ▶ 3D Garment ▶ Re-Target Draping/Re-Drape 3D Arrangement (2025.0) 3D Toolbar ▶ Re-Target Draping/Re-Drape 3D Arrangement (2025.0) ### Operation 1\. Load the avatar which has completed the Create Fitting Suit process. 2\. Add the garment which has Fitting Suit data. \- The garment simulated on the avatar provided by Marvelous Designer (Marvelous Designer 9.5 or above) \- The garment simulated on the avatar having Fitting Suit data after doing Create Fitting Suit. 3\. Select the tool/menu indicated in Location. 4\. Adjust the below options as needed in the popup window, and click OK. Option | Description ---|--- **Maintain Pattern Curvature (%)** | Set the extent of deformation of pattern curvature. * Higher values will deform only the size of the pattern while preserving the existing curvature, while lower values will deform both the size and curvature of the pattern. **Maintain Graphic Size** | ON | Graphics maintain their size after auto fitting OFF | The graphic is automatically resized based on the size changes of the patters. **Maintain Texture Size** | ON | Textures maintain their size after auto fitting OFF | The Texture is automatically resized based on the size changes of the patters. **Maintain Topology** | ON | The topological structure is maintained after auto fitting. ※ Auto Fitting requires all pattern meshes to be fully synchronized to avoid remeshing during simulation. If the mesh is not synchronized, Auto Fitting will attempt to remesh the patterns, which means it cannot preserve the current topology. The simplest way to synchronize the mesh is to run a simulation, and you may need to readjust the UV map afterward. OFF | The topological structure is automatically remeshed and modified during Auto Fitting. → Auto Fitting The size of the garment is automatically adjusted and the garment is simulated on your custom avatar. → Re-Drape 3D Arrangement (ver. 2025.0) The garment maintains its size, UV, textures and is simulated on your custom avatar. ※Note * Before you press the Menu button, increase the particle distance of the 3D garment, which will help this function run faster. * Before you press Menu button, change the property of the 3D garment to its default, which will help this function run efficiently. * * * ## Show Avatar Fitting Suit (Above ver. 11) Please follow the below to see the details of an avatar fitting suit View icons on the 3D window ▶ Avatar Display ▶ Show Avatar Fitting Suit * * * ## Show Garment Fitting Suit (Above ver. 11) Please follow the below to see the details of a garment fitting suit View icons on the 3D window ▶ 3D Garment Display ▶ Show Garment Fitting Suit
content_description: This web page provides comprehensive guidance on creating and utilizing Fitting Suits for custom avatars and garments in the 2025.0 version of the software, including features for Auto Fitting and Re-Target Draping.

Modify UI related settings in the User Interface section. ### Location Main Menu ▶ Settings ▶ User Settings ▶ User Interface Main Menu ▶ Settings/Preferences ▶ Preferences ▶ User Interface (ver 11) ### Operation 1. Adjust the settings below as needed: Unit | Set the measurement unit (inch, centimeter, millimeter) for the program. The software must be restarted for the changes to apply. ---|--- Use Ligne (L) for Button Width | Toggle this option on to adjust button size in ligne (v4.0.0). Default Topstitch Thread Thickness Unit(ver4.2.0) | Choose the default unit for thread thickness (ver4.2.0). Toolbar | 3D Toolbar | Organize the 3D toolbar in the top, bottom, right, or left side of the window (ver4.0.0). 2D Toolbar | Organize the 2D toolbar in the top, bottom, right, or left side of the window (ver4.0.0). Group Tools (ver. 5.1.431) | Group tools of the same category. Activate this option to minimize the problem of hidden tools when using the standard layout. ※Note: All manuals are written with an underlying assumption that the Group Tools option is activated. **Appearance** | Line | **Pattern Outline** : Outline color of 2D Patterns. **Internal Line** : Color of 3D/2D Internal Lines. **Wireframe** : Wireframe color of 3D Patterns. **Selected** : Outline color of the selected object. **Hover** : Outline color of the hovered object. **Font Size** : Font size of 2D Measurements Thickness | **Thickness (Pixels)** : Outline thickness of 2D Patterns. Highlight | **3D Pattern** : Color displayed on selected 3D Patterns. **Freeze** : Color of frozen 3D Patterns. **Strengthen** : Color of 3D Patterns with Strengthen applied. **Layer** : Color of 3D Patterns with Layer applied. **Bond** : Color of 3D/2D Patterns with Bond applied. **Solidify** : Color of 3D Patterns with Solidify applied. **Font** | Font Type | Select the desired font type. Resolution | Automatically Scale Display (ver4.2.0) | When the option is on, the resolution automatically adjusts to the monitor's resolution. When desired, select the desired resolution under the Scaled option.

title: Corporate Firewall Setup and Allowlisting Marvelous Designer Endpoints
content: ### Applicable for: Enterprise users who are using corporate firewall and Allow-listing policies First, make sure you have corporate firewalls and allow-listing policies in place on your network systems. Please contact your company's IT or security team for this allow-listing and firewall setup. ### Note * Marvelous Designer authentication servers only allow HTTPS communication. Therefore, only port 443 is discussed in this article. * Until Marvelous Designer 10 version, the **verify: peer** option inside the Marvelous Designer 10 software was **disabled** , but from Marvelous Designer 11 version it is **enabled** and built and distributed. So if your company uses **SSL Inspection** on your secure network system, please check its detailed settings. * If you need to allow-list Marvelous Designer authentication servers for Marvelous Designer logins on a secure network, add the information below to your security solution. * If you are experiencing problems downloading in-app assets, please add the domain*.clo-set.com to your allow-list. * Non-firewalled customers may not need allow-listing of Marvelous Designer authentication servers. ### If you need allow-listing and use a corporate firewall * IPs to be allow-listed * 52.1.24.50 * 52.20.29.14 * Domains to be allow-listed * sapi.clo3d.com * sapi.clo3d-china.com * *.clo-set.com * Protocol and port to allow-listed * https (443 port) * Enable the Firewall option in Marvelous Designer login window (see the screenshot at the bottom) ### If you need allow-listing but don't use a corporate firewall * IPs to be allow-listed * 52.1.24.50 * 52.20.29.14 * Domains to be allow-listed * api.clo3d.com * api.clo3d-china.com * *.clo-set.com * Protocol and port to allow-listed * https (443 port) * Disable the Firewall option in Marvelous Designer login window (see below figure) ### Firewall option at Marvelous Designer login screen * Note that the information provided below is only for customers using enterprise firewall solutions, not Windows or macOS firewall features. Check with your company's IT or security team whether you use a firewall. ![Firewall=ON, Language=Global.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438418846873)
content_description: This webpage provides essential guidelines for enterprise users on configuring corporate firewalls and allow-listing policies to ensure uninterrupted access to Marvelous Designer authentication servers.

title: Garment Fit Maps
content: ### Objective Utilize four Garment Fit Maps in the 3D window to check 3D Gament's fit. ### Location 3D Window ▶ Hover the Mouse Over the 5th Icon ### Operation 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: 3D Window ▶ Hover the Mouse Over the 5th Icon → Four Garment Fit Maps appear. 2. Refer to the table below and select the desired view icon. Icon | Description ---|--- Stress Map (Below ver. 12) | External stress causing garment distortion per area of the fabric appears in the range of color and numbers. Stress Map appears in a total of eight colors: Red indicates the strongest stress (100kPa) while blue indicates zero distortion (0.00kPa). Other numbers in between are expressed as gradation of two colors. Strain Map | Garment's distortion rate due to external stress appears in percentage. Stain Map appears in a total of eight colors: Red indicates a 120% of distortion rate while blue indicates 100% (no distortion). Numbers in between are expressed as gradation of two colors. Fit Map (Below ver. 12) | Fip Map shows the tightness of the 3D Garment. Can't Wear appears in red indicating not wearable area. Very Tight appears in orange indicating a very tight area. Tight appears in yellow indicating a slightly tight area. Show Pressure Points | Show or hide contact points between 3D Garment and Avatar. → Based on the selected icon, Stress Map, Strain Map, Fit Map, or Pressure Points appear on the 3D Garment.
content_description: Explore the fit of your 3D Garment using four detailed Garment Fit Maps in the 3D window for a comprehensive analysis of stress, strain, tightness, and pressure points.

title: 3D Garment View Controls
content: Zoom in and change view in the 3D window at once. ### Change Camera View Right click on the 3D window to access the pop-up menu. Select the desired view among Front, 3/4 Left, Back, Left, Right, 3/4 Right, Top, Button, or use respective shortcuts (2, 3, 8, 6, 4, 1, 5, 0) to change camera view instantly. ![Captura](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438530878489) ※ Note: #### Camera Direction Change Standards Using the corresponding menu while the avatar is facing a different direction on the screen changes the camera's angle according to the avatar. #### ### Zoom In/Out Shortcuts Zoom In: Hold down the + key on the keyboard to zoom in the 3D window. Zoom Out: Hold down the - key on the keyboard to zoom out the 3D window. ### Zoom to Selected Zoom in/out and rotate the 3D window using the selected Pattern or item as the focal point. Select the desired Pattern or item in the 3D window and locate Main Menu ▶ Display ▶ Viewpoint ▶ Zoom Extends All, Or press the shortcut key F to enlarge the selected object at a fixed scale at the middle and control the view according to it. ![Captura](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438531036313)
content_description: Easily navigate and adjust your 3D view with intuitive camera controls and zoom options for a more immersive experience.

title: Brush Pinching
content: **New in 2026.1** ## **** Apply brush stroke-based pinching to intuitively deform garment surfaces. **** 1. Click ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/60717621680281)the Simulate tool in the 3D toolbar. 2. Click and hold ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/60717621681177)the Quick Pinching tool for more than 2 seconds, then select ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/60717644351257)the Brush Pinching tool from the expanded tool menu. 3. Hover over the garment in the 3D window. 4. Click and drag to apply pinching along the accumulated brush stroke path based on the Strength value. 5. Set the Brush and Pinching options if needed. **Brush** **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Size** | Adjusts the brush size. **Focal Radius** | Adjusts the size of the focal area. **Lazy Distance** | Adjusts the length of the Stroke Trail. **Display Weights** | Displays the weighted area along the accumulated brush stroke. **Pinching** **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Strength** | Adjusts the strength of the pinching deformation. **Push Inward** | Applies pinching inward. **Average Radius** | Adjusts the reference area used to stabilize the Pinching direction by averaging surrounding normals.
content_description: Discover how to intuitively deform garment surfaces using brush stroke-based pinching in the latest 2026.1 update.

title: AI Pose Generator (Beta)
content: **New in 2025.1** **** Effortlessly create avatar poses using keywords or an image. _***** AI Pose Generator is being piloted as a Beta service, and may be suspended to provide better service. _ **** 1. Click Avatar ▶ **AI Pose Generator (Beta)** in the top menu. 2. Generate a pose image by entering prompts or upload it directly. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Prompt** | Select the gender, and enter your prompt. **✨ Writing Tips:** Listing the desired words rather than long descriptive sentences can generate more effective results. ![Comment.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/48949194772249)**Keyword Suggestions** | Suggested keywords will appear as you type to help you complete your prompt. ![icon_pin_off.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/48949194782873)**Maintain Prompt** | Even if the same prompts are used, the AI pose image is created anew each time. Thus, clicking the Maintain Prompt button may update the prompts while preserving the existing results as much as possible. The results may differ from the existing ones depending on the addition or change of the prompts. ![icon_random_dice.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/48949194786841) **Random** | Sample prompts are provided randomly **Image** | Click the **Upload** button to load a pose image that fits the following guidelines: A full-body image from head to toe is highly recommended to ensure the highest quality of the AI Pose. 3. Click ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/48949194794265) Button to generate the pose based on your image. It may take a while to create when there are many users at the same time. 4. Click ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/48949194796057) Button to save the generated pose as the *.pos file.
content_description: Discover the AI Pose Generator (Beta), a seamless tool for effortlessly creating custom avatar poses using keywords or images, designed to enhance your creative experience in 2025.1.

title: Graphic Style Properties (Ver. 2025.0)
content: Graphic Style Properties Material PBR (Default) Individual Graphic Properties Options ## ## Graphic Style Properties ### Location Main Menu ▶Materials ▶ Graphics ### Objective Set the graphic properties. ### Location 2D Toolbar ▶ Transform Graphic ### Operation #### Properties Graphic Style 1. Object Browser ▶ Click a graphic style in the Graphic Tab → The selected graphic's properties appear in the Property Editor. 2. Set the properties of the Graphic Style Properties | Description ---|--- Information | Name/Item No. | Enter a name or an item number of the graphic. Material | Configure the graphic's material, texture, color, and transparency. Graphic Configuration | Face | Place the graphic on the front, back, or both sides. Tile | Tile the graphic along the X or Y axis of a Pattern while maintaining its original size. ※ Note: The same option is available in the right-click pop-up menu. Over Seamline (ver 10) | Place the graphic on the seam of patterns. ※Note: \- Graphic does not appear when the difference of the seam is over the allowable extent. \- Graphic may not match when it is placed over the curves. In this case, deactivate this option and adjust the graphic manually. Fur Trimmer (ver 2026.0) | Show the graphic clearly when using Fur (Render) and Fur_Strand materials. No fur is generated in the graphic area. Graphic Transformation | Adjust the rotation angle, width, height, and Z-Offset(ver MD10) of the graphic. ## Material PBR (Default) Edit each property for the Front / Back / Side of the mesh. Option | Description ---|--- Type | Select the desired Material Type. Fabric_Matte, Fabric_Shiny, Fabric_Silk/Satin, Fabric_Velvet, Fur_Strand, Leather, Metal, Plastic Base Color Map | Color | Select a color by selecting the Square or using color codes. Click the Explore button ( ![Explore Button.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438193601177) ) and apply a Graphic image from Library/Folder. Click the Trash can icon to delete the graphic image from the scene. Recolor | Desaturate | Desaturate the entire Base Color Map to remove color and convert it into grayscale or black and white. Switch | Easily and quickly switch the color of a solid Graphic to a new one without losing the accuracy of the chosen color. ![Switch Color.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438193814553) ※Note: For consistent results, the Base Color Map should contain 1 color. If the Base Color Map contains multiple colors, users may experience unexpected or unintended results. Normal Map | Texture image that stores surface normal information in an RBG image. Use the same map as the Fabric ON / OFF toggle (this turns off the intensity slider) Intensity | When a texture or graphic is applied, a Normal Map may be generated by clicking the Generate icon. (![GenerateButton.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438222925721) ) Adjust the Intensity with the slider. Higher intensity results in more pronounced details, and a lower intensity makes the details lower to the surface. When this option is selected, the shinny part becomes dull and vice-versa. To use Specular Maps provided in below Ver. 6, check this option. Reflection Intensity | Greater the Reflection Intensity value is, more reflective than the material or Graphic is and vice-versa. Metalness | Partially express metallics using a grayscale image. title: Proxy Server Setting
content: * Note Marvelous Designer has removed the Proxy Server option from version 11 and onward, in order to enhance the security for users. If users however, wish to continue using the Proxy Server in their network system, then please refer below. **Objective** Set the proxy server through environment variables provided by the OS * Note: Only HTTP/HTTPS protocol is supported. **Operation** 1\. Click the start button on the taskbar. 2\. Click Edit environment variables. 3\. Environment Variables ▶System Variable ▶ Click the New... and enter the proxy server information **Information** | **When using IP** | **When Using User ID/ Password** ---|---|--- **Variable name** | PROXY_HTTP (Capital letter) * Note: When connecting to a proxy server using HTTPS, the variable name must be entered as PROXY_HTTPS. **Variable value** | ip:port E.g) 12.34.56.78:80 | Id:password@url:port E.g) MD:password123@example.com:8080 * Note: On Mac, you need to enter environment variables in Shell Profile. (Bash Shell: ~/.bash_profile, Z Shell: ~/.zprofile) ![__1.PNG](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438270782105) ![__2.PNG](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438257671577)
content_description: This webpage provides essential instructions for configuring a proxy server using environment variables in Marvelous Designer version 11 and later, following the removal of the Proxy Server option for enhanced security.

title: Pattern Drafter (Beta)
content: **New in 2025.1** Open Measurement Options Edit Pattern AI Pattern Drafter (Beta) **** Easily Create your First Pattern within Marvelous Designer, using either measurement points or your flat sketches. **** ### **Open** 1. Click the 2D ▶ **Pattern Drafter (Beta)** in the top menu. 2. Choose the type of Shirt Style. 3. From there you will then see your Simple Measurements Populate below. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/49696317429785) **** ### **Measurements Options** 1. You have 3 different options for how you want to view and adjust your measurements for you patterns. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **General** | This will give you a complete list of the most commonly used Points of Measure for that style. **Simple** | This will give you the most commonly used points of measure for simple editing of patterns. **Custom** | This is automatically adjust to Custom when you select your own measurement list and customize to your preference. 1\. Click ![setting.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/48950075963417) **Setting** button to view the full list of measurements. 2\. Use the checkbox to show or hide items as needed. 3\. Once setup is complete, click ![Total-1.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/48950075968153) **Exit** button to apply changes. 2. If you have an avatar to draft the pattern for, open the avatar first, then click the ![Match to Avatar.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/61502256264089) **Match to Avatar Size**. **(ver 2026.1)** * If the button is disabled, restart Pattern Drafter and try again. → The pattern measurements are automatically adjusted to match the avatar's size. ※ **Note:** Currently, this feature is available only for Marvelous Designer default avatars. 3. Enter your pattern measurement values. _**✨Tip:** _ ▪️You can return each measurement to its original value individually by clicking ![reset.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/48950075972761) **Reset** button. ▪️Certain Measurements include ![Total.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/48950075974169)**Total** option to input the full front and back circumference. ▪️Certain measurements include dropdown options, as they are commonly taken from different areas of the pattern. **\- Total Length:** High Point Shoulder, Or Center Front/ Back **\- Across Front/ Back:** 4", 5" or 6" from High Point shoulder **\- Across Waist:** 4", 5" or 6" from Armhole **\- Across Bust/ Chest:** Armhole to Armhole or 1" from Armhole **\- Bicep Width:** Armhole to Armhole or 1" from Armhole ▪️For the Front and Back Body, you can choose between **Symmetry** and **Half Symmetry**. ▪️You can view all inactive measurements in each section by clicking ![list.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/48950075975321) **Show All Measurements** icon. #### #### ### **Edit Pattern (ver 2026.0)** Patterns created with Pattern Drafter can be edited while retaining their original parameters. 1. Open the Pattern Drafter. → If a parametric pattern exists, select whether to create a new pattern or edit it. 2. Select the ![Frame 215.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/56586933637529) button. → The pattern type is automatically detected. 3. Change the measurement values, then click the ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/56586900700953)**** button. Or, click ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/56586900704025) button to generate a new parametric pattern. ### **AI Pattern Drafter (Beta)** Using a Sketch Marvelous Designer will Automatically generate measurements to create a drafted pattern for you. 1. Click ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/49886528028441) **AI Pattern Drafter (Beta)** button on the top right of the Pattern Drafter. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/48950276717721) 2. If you have an avatar to draft the pattern for, open the avatar first, then select the **Match to Avatar** option. **(ver 2026.1)** * If the button is disabled, restart AI Pattern Drafter and try again. ※Note: Currently, this feature is available only for Marvelous Designer default avatars. 3. Generate a background image to be composited by entering prompts or upload it directly. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Text Prompt** | Select the garment type and write in your sketch idea. Make sure to add in as many descriptive words as possible. if you want to emphasize something place it in brackets. ※ Supporting Type: **T-Shirts, Pants, and Skirts.** (There will be more coming.) **✨ Writing Tips:** Listing the desired words rather than long descriptive sentences can generate more effective results. ![Comment.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/48950284431001)**Keyword Suggestions** | Suggested keywords will appear as you type to help you complete your prompt. ![icon_pin_off.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/48950276732057)**Maintain Prompt** | Even if the same prompts are used, the AI Face image is created anew each time. Thus, clicking the Maintain Prompt button may update the prompts while preserving the existing results as much as possible. The results may differ from the existing ones depending on the addition or change of the prompts. ![icon_random_dice.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/48950276734489) **Random** | Sample prompts are provided randomly ![Editor Edit.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/48950276735257) **Clear** | Clear anything that was written to restart. **Image** | Click the **Upload** button to load a face image that fits the following guidelines: A schematic image of the garment with black lines on a white background is highly recommended to ensure the highest quality of the AI Pattern. Ensure the image shows the garment only. 4. Click ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/48950276738969) button and an image will be generated for you to choose from. This process can be replicated until you get the desired outcome. Your image history can be found on the right side of the window.
content_description: Discover the new **Pattern Drafter (Beta)** in Marvelous Designer 2025.1, enabling users to effortlessly create and customize patterns using measurement points or flat sketches.

title: Internal Line Variable Fold Angle
content: **New in 2026.1** **** Apply a fold angle that tapers from one end of an internal line to the other, creating smoother and more gradual folds across a pattern (e.g., a front crease on formal trousers). **** 1. Select the **Edit Pattern** tool from the 2D toolbar. 2. Click on an internal line to select it. → The **Fold** section appears in the Property Editor with two toggle buttons: **Uniform** and **Variable**. 3. Select a fold mode: * **Uniform** _(default)_ : The **Fold Angle** value is applied uniformly across the entire internal line. Behaviour is identical to previous versions. * **Variable** : The **Fold Angle** value is applied at one end of the line and tapers to flat (180°) at the other end. 4. Adjust the **Fold Angle** slider (0–360°) to set the angle at the active end. 5. _(Variable only)_ Click the **⇄** icon next to the **Variable** button to reverse the direction — swapping which end carries the fold angle and which end is flat. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/60718530459545) **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/59783425421593)** **📝****Note:** For symmetric internal lines, switching the fold mode and adjusting the angle is automatically mirrored to the symmetric counterpart. To edit each side independently, right-click the internal line and select **Remove Linked Editing** first.
content_description: Discover the new fold angle feature in 2026.1 that allows for smoother, tapered folds along internal lines, enhancing the design of patterns like formal trousers.

title: Viewport Camera
content: #### New in 2026.1 #### **Import Camera** **Export Camera** **Set Main Camera** **Delete Camera** **Default Camera** * * * Camera data can be imported and exported with supported 3D file formats to preserve scene views across different software environments. * * * ### **Import Camera** Camera objects can be imported from supported **FBX** and **glTF 2.0 (glTF/GLB)** files. 1. Go to **File > Import > ****FBX** or **glTF 2.0 (glTF** or **GLB)**. 2. In the **Import** dialog, enable **Cameras** in the **Object** section. → Camera objects included in the file are imported with the scene. 3. Click **OK** to import the file. → Imported cameras are added to the scene and displayed in the Scene Graph. * * * ### **Export Camera** Camera objects can be exported with supported **FBX** and **glTF 2.0 (glTF/GLB)** files. 1. Go to **File > Export > FBX **or **glTF 2.0 (glTF/GLB)** 2. In the **Export** dialog, enable **Include****Camera** in the **Object** section. → Camera objects in the scene are included in the exported file. 3. Click **OK** to export the file. * * * ### **Set Main Camera** A camera in the Scene Graph can be set as the **Main Camera** from the context menu. The Main Camera is used as the active camera for scene viewing and workflows that require a representative camera view. 1. In the **Scene Graph** , right-click the camera you want to use as the Main Camera. 2. Select **Set as Main Camera** from the context menu. → The selected camera is set as the Main Camera. 3. The Main Camera status is updated in the Scene Graph. → The selected camera is displayed as the current Main Camera. **※****Note:** Only one camera can be set as the Main Camera at a time. * * * ### **Delete Cameras** Camera objects can be deleted from the Scene Graph. 1. In the **Scene Graph** , right-click the camera you want to delete. 2. Select **Delete** from the context menu. → The selected camera is deleted immediately. → The camera is removed from the Scene Graph. **※ Note:** The **Default Camera** cannot be deleted. The **Delete** action is disabled for the Default Camera. * * * ### **Default Camera** A scene always requires a Default Camera. If a scene does not contain a camera with the Default flag, a new **Default Camera** is created when **New Project** is executed.
content_description: This web page provides guidance on managing camera objects in your 3D scenes, including importing, exporting, setting, deleting, and designating default cameras using supported file formats.

title: FABRIC PHYSICAL PROPERTIES: Adjust Collision Thickness
content: ### Objective Simulation thickness is invisible set property that represents the collision limit for Garments to result smooth Simulation. By default, the Simulation thickness from the Garment Pattern is set 1.5mm on each side, for a total of 3mm, and this value is adjustable as required. Lower the thickness value to work on Garments that are more likely to be form-fitting, or increase the thickness value to use as padding and etc. ※ Note: For the same reason, the default value of Avatar thickness (Skin Offset) is set for 3mm. For form-fitting Garments or accurate fitting measurement, it is recommended that Skin Offset is adjusted alongside the Simulation thickness. ### Location Select Pattern in 2D/3D Window ▶ Property Editor ▶ Simulation Properties ▶ Add'l Thickness-Collision ### Operation 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Select Pattern in 2D/3D Window ▶ Property Editor ▶ Simulation Properties ▶ Add'l Thickness-Collision 2. Enter desired rendering thickness value. →The thickness is now being adjusted and applied. **※ Updated in 2026.1** **Collision Thickness** has been improved so that its thickness direction matches **Rendering Thickness** , ensuring that the visible thickness and simulation collision are applied consistently.
content_description: This webpage provides guidance on adjusting the simulation thickness property for garments to achieve optimal collision limits and fit in 3D modeling software.

title: Blend Shape Avatar
content: **ver 2026.0** **** Blend Shape is a technology that creates natural forms by blending various pre-made body types or facial expressions at desired ratios. With just a single base model, Blend Shape allows for real-time and flexible transformations, ranging from various target body sizes to subtle facial expressions. This feature enables users to import avatars containing Blend Shape data into Marvelous Designer, allowing for instantaneous body changes and precise dynamic fitting. **📝 Note:** To use this feature, you should import files that contain Blend Shape data. ### **Workflow** 1. Load a file containing Blend Shape data as an Avatar type. 2. Go to Main Menu → Avatar → **Avatar Editor** to open the Avatar Editor 3. Click on the **Blend Shape** tab in the Avatar Editor 4. Check the list of **Deformable Parameters** included in the loaded avatar. 5. Adjust the weight of the desired part between 0 and 100 to modify the shape. #### ### **Options** 1. Select Avatar * This option is displayed when multiple Blend Shape avatars are loaded; it will not appear if only a single avatar is present. * Selecting an avatar will display the corresponding Deformable Parameters for that specific avatar. 2. Deformable Parameters * The list of deformable parameters included by the creator is grouped and displayed by mesh unit. * Each parameter can be set as a **Favorite**. By enabling **Show Favorites Only** in the top right, you can manage the list efficiently by displaying only your favorited items. * Clicking the **Reset** button will revert all unsaved changes to their initial values. * Enable **Show Selected Only** to display only the items related to the selected **3D Avatar** part. (ver 2026.1) ### ### **Blend Shape Animation** ※ Updated in 2026.1 Click **Add Animation Keyframe** on the right side of a **Deformable Parameter** list item to set the corresponding property value as a keyframe at the **Current Frame**. **Blend Shape Animation** can be imported and exported using **FBX, glTF/GLB, Alembic, and USD** file formats.
content_description: Discover how to harness the power of Blend Shape technology in Marvelous Designer for seamless, real-time avatar transformations and dynamic fitting.

title: Graphics Card Problems and Troubleshooting
content: 1\. By updating the graphics card driver, you can solve and prevent graphics card-related problems that may occur while using the Marvelous Designer software. 2\. Guides you on how to properly connect your desktop graphics card and monitor. ### Applicable for: All users of Marvelous Designer software * * * # **Common Problems** 1\. OpenGL version warning appears when running Marvelous Designer software as shown in the figure below. ![Screen_Shot_2022-10-20_at_9.37.19_PM.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438272879385) 2\. Graphics/texture errors or rendering images appear strange while running Marvelous Designer software. 3\. If the Marvelous Designer GPU-simulation or GPU-rendering speed is lower than the expected performance of your computer's specifications. * * * ## How to Update Graphics Card Driver Step 1) Find out the product name of the graphics card (GPU) installed in your desktop computer or laptop. * As shown in the figure below, you can find the model name of your graphics card (GPU) in the Performance tab of Windows Device Manager. ![002_Task_Manager.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438289814041) Step 2) Search and download the latest driver matching the product name from each manufacturer's website. * Note that even if the graphics card model name looks the same or similar, the drivers for laptops and desktops, and for workstations and servers are different. Search for and install the driver for the type of computer you are using. * [AMD Radeon Driver Download (Link)](https://www.amd.com/en/support) * [Nvidia Driver Download (Link)](https://www.nvidia.com/Download/index.aspx?lang=en) * [Intel Graphics Driver Download (Link)](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/download-center/home.html) Step 3) Run the downloaded driver file. It is recommended to install with administrator privileges. * A computer reboot may be required after driver installation. Follow the on-screen instructions. ![003_RunAsAdministrator.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438273265561) * * * ## Connecting the monitor and graphics card correctly As shown in the figure below, if the monitor cable is connected to the CPU built-in GPU, the built-in GPU is mainly used instead of the external graphics card. OpenGL version warnings may occur when running Marvelous Designer in this situation. ![004_Connectors.JPG](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438293924505) **How to fix** Step 1) Save the files you are working on and turn off the computer completely. Step 2) Connect the monitor cable to the external graphics card and turn on the computer. Connect all monitor cables to the external graphics card, even when using more than one monitor. Step 3) If there is no screen output on the monitor, try reconnecting the monitor power. **See also** * Supported monitor cable types vary depending on the graphic card and monitor. * If you are using the latest monitor and the latest graphic card, most support HDMI or DP (DisplayPort). * Find the right cable for your monitor and graphics card. [Saved search (Link)](https://www.google.com/search?q=monitor+cable+types&oq=monitor+cable) * * * ## Read more * Marvelous Designer software automatically detects the graphics card and driver installed in the computer when launching, and displays a warning if an unsupported graphics card or outdated driver is found. Please refer to the guide above to solve the problem. * If you are using a laptop with an Nvidia graphics card, the laptop will have either an AMD processor or an Intel processor with integrated graphics GPU and Nvidia GPU, respectively, depending on the situation. If an openGL-related error appears while using the Marvelous Designer software, select 'High-performance Nvidia processor' in the Nvidia control panel as shown below and click Apply. ![005_Nvidia_Control_Panel.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438278923929) * If you set Windows Update to 'Auto', it will automatically install the latest graphics card driver. However, the driver provided by the graphics card manufacturer's website is more up-to-date than the Windows update version. * It is recommended to update the graphics card driver at least once every 6 months. It helps with Marvelous Designer software as well as all other graphics programs and overall system performance and stability. * To check GPU usage in Windows, select GPU in the Performance tab of Task Manager as shown below. For Windows 11 users, use a dedicated utility like [GPU-z (freeware, download link)](https://www.techpowerup.com/gpuz/) ![006_CUDA.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438294373401) * If you are using a Mac, the graphics card driver is included in macOS. If you update to the latest macOS, the latest graphics card driver is also installed. * To check CPU-GPU usage on Mac, use the Activity Monitor app built-in to macOS. * Also check the [Marvelous Designer system requirements ](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358219834649)for graphics card-related information.
content_description: This web page provides essential guidance for Marvelous Designer users on updating graphics card drivers and properly connecting their desktop graphics card to ensure optimal software performance and prevent graphics-related issues.

title: Marvelous Designer Student License Reorganization: 4-Year Usage and 3-Month Free Benefit Guide (updated July 2026)
content: The student license policy for Marvelous Designer, a 3D design software, has been newly reorganized. It will change from the existing annual plan to a more flexible monthly subscription method, and can be used for up to 4 years from the date of certification. In particular, a special 3-month free benefit is provided for new subscribers until October 31, 2026, so please check the major changes. ### 1\. Summary of Major Changes to Marvelous Designer Student Plan Category | Existing Policy | New Policy ---|---|--- Usage Period | Annual license, max 2 times (total 2 years) | 4 years from the date of initial student certification License Type | Annual License (Student annual) | Monthly Subscription Special Benefit | None | 3 months free upon new subscription (ends Oct 31, 2026) ### 2\. 2026 Updated Student License Detailed Benefits #### Generous usage period guaranteed for up to 4 years * As long as you maintain student status, you can use Marvelous Designer for up to 4 years from the date of your initial student certification. * The existing 'maximum 2 times' renewal limit has been abolished, so you can freely turn your subscription on and off at any time within the 4-year window (usage period). * Note: Regardless of the number of times you previously purchased an annual license (Student annual), you can purchase a monthly subscription within the same 4-year period. * _(Example: If you completed your initial student certification on July 1, 2026, you can receive student plan benefits until July 1, 2030.)_ #### Introduction of affordable monthly subscription (Monthly Subscription) * Now the student plan is unified into a monthly subscription method. (Existing Student annual licenses will no longer be sold to new customers.) * At an affordable price of $8.25 per month, you can flexibly subscribe and cancel according to your own learning plan, such as during vacations or semester projects. #### Exclusive 3-month free special benefit for new subscribers (Limited time) * We offer a "3-month free usage benefit" to everyone who starts a monthly subscription for the first time after student certification. * For those who have used the annual license (Student annual) in the past, the 3-month free benefit will be applied equally when starting a new monthly subscription for the first time. * Benefit End Date: This special benefit will end completely on October 31, 2026, so we recommend starting your subscription within the benefit period. * Payment Information: When the 3-month free period ends, $8.25 per month will be automatically billed. However, if you cancel your subscription during the free period and then re-subscribe, the benefit will not be restored and you will be charged immediately. ### 3\. Information for Existing Annual License (Student annual) Users * If you currently have an active annual license (Student annual), you can continue to use the program as before until the remaining license expiration date. * Even after expiration, if your student plan usage period (4 years from initial certification) remains, you can continue to use it by switching to a new monthly subscription plan. ### 4\. Marvelous Designer Student License Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) * **Q. What is the difference between Personal and Student License?** * A: There are no differences in features or Asset Store access between the Student license and the Personal license. Both versions provide the same tools, functions, updates, and content access. The only difference is in the license usage terms: * **Student License:** For academic, learning, and non-commercial school-related work only. * **Personal License:** For personal projects, portfolio building, and commercial/freelance work. * **Q. How do I verify my student eligibility?** * A: By clicking on the "[Start Now](https://marvelousdesigner.com/pricing?type=academic)" button for the student license, the school email verification process will begin. An authentication email will be sent through your school email, and you can proceed with authentication through the email. If you are unable to authenticate through your school email, please proceed with authentication through "Manual Input" or "Document Submission." * **Q. Can I cancel my student license subscription midway?** * A. You can freely cancel and resubscribe within 4 years from initial certification. * **Q. Where can I check the remaining period and end date of my student plan?** * A: After logging in to the official website, you can check the exact end date of your student plan next to the [MyPage] - [ID TYPE] information. * **Q. I am still a student even after 4 years because I am in a 4-year university or in graduate school. Can I extend the period?** * A: Currently, the student plan system is fixed to a 'maximum of 4 years from the date of initial certification', regardless of the degree program. * **Q. Exactly how much is the student plan monthly subscription fee?** * A: During the first 3 months of the free benefit period (ending October 31, 2026), the payment amount is $0, and after that period ends, $8.25 will be charged every month. * **Q. What would happen after the 4 years duration terminates? Would it be automatically converted to a Personal subscription?** * A: When 4 years from initial certification passes, your monthly Student subscription will be automatically terminated and won’t be automatically converted to a Personal Subscription.
content_description: Discover the newly reorganized Marvelous Designer student license policy, offering a flexible monthly subscription for up to 4 years with a special 3-month free benefit for new subscribers until October 31, 2026.
